faq.q: What types of detached houses sit under $1.8M in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: From the live feed's own cards and copy, the band is detached houses across the city — newer family homes in Albion, established homes in East Central and West Central, and acreage houses in Whonnock — rather than attached product, whose community median is $525,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Is $1.8 million the top of the Maple Ridge market, or its mainstream?
faq.a: The mainstream, on the published medians: the September 2026 community medians are $1,131,000 detached and $525,000 for Condos & Townhomes, so the $1.8M ceiling sits above the typical sale price of either type in the city — that is a comparison of medians to the ceiling, not a count of listings inside the band (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which school district serves Maple Ridge, including its acreage areas?
faq.a: SD42 Maple Ridge–Pitt Meadows; catchments are address-based and there is no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12) — at the downtown sample address used here (11897 227 Street) the locator gives Eric Langton Elementary and Thomas Haney Secondary; confirm any acreage address with the SD42 School Locator.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
